root_cause.text: The generic PHY driver (genphy) was allowed to call phy_sfp_probe() which triggers sfp_bus_add_upstream() while the RTNL lock is held (since genphy probing runs under RTNL), causing a deadlock because sfp_bus_add_upstream() expects not to be called with RTNL held.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "running sfp_bus_add_upstream() for genphy deadlocks, as for genphy the PHY probing runs under RTNL, which isn't the case for non-genphy drivers." The patch adds a guard to skip phy_sfp_probe() when `!phydev->is_genphy_driven` to prevent this deadlock.
